architectureDecisions: D1 — opencodeTool = defineAgentTool({ id: 'opencode', command: 'opencode', prefixArgs: [], versionArgs: ['--version'], buildInvocation, parseResult }). AGENT_TOOLS.opencode = opencodeTool. Export opencodeTool from tool-adapters.js and index.js. Adapter never reads homedir or ~/.opencode; operators use PATH or --command.

D2 — buildInvocation uses spawn cwd via request.cwd when it is a non-empty string. Args: ['run','--format','json', ...(cwd?['--dir',cwd]:[]), ...(model?['--model',model]:[]), ...permissionArgs, ...resumeArgs, prompt]. WORKSPACE_EDIT permissionArgs=[]; FULL_AUTO=['--auto']. Resume: sessionRef string → ['--session', sessionRef]; resume non-null without sessionRef → ['--continue']; resume null → []. stdin is always null. Do not pass top-level --prompt. Extra request fields such as logFile are ignored.

D3 — process-runner runAgentInvocation calls tool.buildInvocation({ ...request, timeoutMs, cwd }). Existing adapters ignore cwd. supervisor.js writes request including cwd: workspace.root. observation runObservedInvocation always sets request.cwd. If BB-105 already plumbed cwd, reuse it. redactArgv already rebuilds from the same request.

D4 — parseResult reads JSONL stdout. claimedSuccess = exitCode===0. sessionRef = first string sessionID on a parsed object, else null. finalMessage = last step text part or lastLines(stdout). parseOpencodeJsonl(stdout,{truncated}) walks lines: type==='step_finish' with part.tokens.input and part.tokens.output as integers are counted; sum input/output; optional reasoning and cache.read only when every counted event reported them; totalCostUsd is the sum of finite Number(part.cost), else null (opencode-only extra field; Codex/Kiro/agy usage objects stay six fields). source 'opencode.step_finish'. unavailableReason null only when at least one counted event exists. Missing/unparseable → OPENCODE_USAGE_NOT_REPORTED; truncated without those integers → OPENCODE_JSONL_TRUNCATED. toolEvents = { counts by type, invalidLines }. parseToolOutput('opencode', invocation) dispatches here.

D5 — CLI: USAGE and baseTool accept opencode. probe iterates AGENT_TOOLS so opencode appears as {installed,version}. smoke --tool opencode uses the same skip reasons. AT4 probe JSON must include opencode:{installed:false,version:null} on empty PATH beside whatever tools already exist (codex, kiro, agy, and grok if AGENT_TOOLS.grok exists). Live smoke stays out of npm test and npm run verify.

D6 — fake-opencode.mjs: --version prints 'fake-opencode 0.0.0'; honors FAKE_AGENT_SCENARIO like fake-agent.mjs (FIX_FIRST writes the built-in sum fix); prints JSONL including step_start, text, step_finish { part: { type:'step-finish', reason:'stop', tokens:{input,output,reasoning,cache:{read,write}}, cost } }. Fixtures opencode-usage.jsonl and opencode-no-usage.jsonl cover the parser. Tests never spawn a real opencode binary.

D7 — Evidence: executed opencode-cli-probe-result.json (version 1.18.33, HOME_INSTALL_EXISTS not on PATH, run --help flags --format json --dir --model --auto --continue --session positional message, --prompt absent on run, missing binary ENOENT, liveModelRun false). Delivered AGENT_TOOLS / parseToolOutput / runSupervisedTask / runObservedInvocation.

D8 — Living docs: state.md adapter table and CLI USAGE include opencode; observation.md per-tool row for opencode JSONL usage/cost; docs/living/system/state.md one-line inventory; packages/agent-tools/README.md. Living docs contain no Blackboard ids.
